title: Regulator Export Primitive v1
description: Schema for P35 RegulatorExport — produces compliance evidence in regulator-accepted formats. Closes GAP-E1 (EU AI Act Art. 11/Annex IV technical documentation, Art. 47/Annex V EU declaration of conformity) and partially GAP-E4 (GPAI Art. 51-56). Translates internal ComplianceReport output into regulator-accepted export envelopes. Status: IMPLEMENTED — module + tests shipped.

export_id.description: Unique identifier for this export envelope (UUID or deterministic hash).

framework.description: Target regulatory framework. Determines the format and required fields.

format.description: Regulator-accepted format for the export. Maps to the specific annex/section of the framework.

system_name.description: Name of the AI system being documented.

provider_name.description: Legal entity providing the AI system (EU AI Act Art. 3(28) provider).

intended_purpose.description: Intended purpose per EU AI Act Art. 9(2)(a) / Art. 13.

risk_classification.description: EU AI Act risk tier per Art. 6 / Art. 51.

system_identity.description: Identity of the AI system and provider. Required for all regulator-facing exports.

control_reference.description: Human-readable citation of the control requirement.

coverage_state.description: Coverage state per the coverage matrix taxonomy.

source.description: Primitive or module that produced the evidence.

artifact_ref.description: Reference to the evidence artifact (receipt hash, log path, test name).

signed.description: Whether the evidence is cryptographically signed.

boundary_note.description: For partial/boundary coverage: what the customer-org must complete.

evidence_bundle.description: The evidence bundle — per-control evidence with coverage state.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the export was generated.

operator_approval.description: Must be true. Enforces D5 (NO_AUTO_PROMOTION) — regulator exports cannot be auto-generated for submission without operator approval.

approver_id.description: Identity of the operator approving the export.

authority.description: Authority gate: operator must approve before a regulator-facing export is finalized.

export_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical JSON export body. Tamper-evident seal.

previous_export_hash.description: Hash of the prior export for the same framework, enabling hash-chain verification across export iterations.

receipt_ref.description: Reference to the governance receipt recording this export (K1 RECEIPT).

integrity.description: Integrity seal: hash-chained proof of export contents.

boundary_disclaimer.description: Statutory boundary disclaimer. HUMMBL is not a Notified Body / certification body / CPA firm. This export is technical evidence, not a legal conformity declaration.
